text:
mira-docs: quick ping  opened a docs PR to migrate the Console "observability" dashboard example to the new telemetry shape. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/9012
sam-eng: thanks. what's the main delta?
mira-docs: two things: runtime now emits `traceId` (camelCase) instead of `trace_key`, and cost fields moved to `estimated_cost_usd`. examples + screenshot caption still reference old names and one presets anchor 404s.
indra-ml: correct — runtime change went out last week. we kept backwards compat for a bit but we should update docs to avoid confusion. also suggest a short migration note for older SDKs.
ben-sdk: i'll update node and python snippets in the PR. wondering if we should show both shapes (legacy -> new) or just the new one with a one-line note?
ryan-ux: UX note: the dashboard panel title currently reads "Cost by tracekey" in the image. please change to "Cost by trace ID" (sentence case) and update alt text + caption to match exactly.
mira-docs: let's keep only the new example and add a one-paragraph migration note: "Older SDKs may emit `trace_key`; map to `traceId` in your frontend." avoids duplicating screenshots.
sam-eng: i'll patch the dashboard markdown, replace the broken presets anchor with the canonical presets doc, and update the image alt text.
ben-sdk: pushed snippet edits to the PR: Node example:
```js
// attach trace id to tracehook
tracehook.record({ traceId: payload.traceId, estimated_cost_usd: payload.estimated_cost_usd })
```
Python example:
```py
# attach trace id to tracehook
tracehook.record({"traceId": payload["traceId"], "estimated_cost_usd": payload["estimated_cost_usd"]})
```
Go sample adjusted to use EstimatedCostUSD in struct.
indra-ml: small API note: telemetry.v1 now nests these fields under `telemetry.v1.metrics` in some responses; maybe add a brief example path to avoid users looking at the wrong object.
ryan-ux: also, change UI copy in the screenshot to exact: "Cost by trace ID (estimated)"? that might be too wordy. suggest exactly "Cost by trace ID".
mira-docs: agreed, "Cost by trace ID" only. i'll update caption to: Screenshot shows Console > Observability > Cost by trace ID.
ci-bot: link-check for PR #9012: presets anchor -> 404, playground example -> 200, other links -> 200.
sam-eng: replaced presets anchor with /docs/console/presets canonical link and removed the stray playground redirect. pushed.
ci-bot: PR #9012 checks: links all passed, tests passed.
mira-docs: merged. thanks all. leaving thread open in case SDK owners need to backport the note to older docs. :thumbsup:
